content:
Asha: Heads-up — we got a noisy cluster of 429 spikes starting ~08:12 UTC for a handful of orgs. Not a hard outage but trending toward an SLO blip. Logging details below, need quick alignment on alert behavior + dashboard slices.

OpsBot: monitor/api-429-rate fired (severity: warning) for group=production - query=rate(api_requests_total{status=\"429\"}[1m]) > 0.05

Mira: on it — can you paste per-org numbers? CS is seeing three support tickets referencing timeouts from the same customer.

Asha: Copy. Top offenders by 5m window: org-42 (3.5% of requests 429), org-9 (1.8%), org-ttl (0.9%). Overall 429% across prod = 0.6% but spike peaked at 1.2% for a few mins.

Jamal: Any recent routing changes or model rollouts? Could be a variant mismatch causing sync issues with KV cache.

Tomas: I saw a canary rollout for model-x-v2 ~07:50 UTC that increased concurrency on pool-gpu-b. Might be related.

Asha: Good call. Early hypothesis: burst + routing to model-x-v2 introduced transient queuing -> 429s from our front door.

Lina: Dashboard note — current org-level tile groups by total qps and 429 rate, but it smooths with a 5m average which hides short bursts. Recommend adding a 1m heatmap view and a per-key recent-errors table.

Mira: For CS playbook: if org 429 rate > 2% for >10m, notify CS and offer temporary burst lift. Otherwise just log and monitor. Thoughts?

Jamal: Agree. Also add an automated mitigation path: if per-key 429 rate > 3% for >3m, automatically switch routing policy to prefer lower-concurrency pool and enable fallback model for that key for 5 minutes.

Asha: Proposed alert tiers:
- P0 pager: whole-prod 429 rate > 1.0% sustained for 10m OR > 3% for 3m.
- P1 page to oncall: any single org > 5% for 5m.
- Slack warning (ops-silent): per-org > 1% for 5m.

Tomas: Also add aggregation/grouping keys for monitors: group by org_id and api_key to avoid paging for single noisy keys. Datadog monitor example:
```
avg(last_5m):sum:api.requests{status:429}.as_count() by {org_id} / sum:api.requests{}.as_count() by {org_id} > 0.02
```
Alert grouping = true, notify_no_data = false.

Lina: Dashboard panels to add: 1m 429 spike histogram, per-key recent errors (last 15m), routing pool utilization, model-variant latency + 429 rate. Add quick filters for org and api_key.

Mira: Runbook draft for SRE ops when alert fires:
1) Check per-org dashboard + logs (click through link)
2) Identify if it's routing/model related (check rollout flag and pool utilization)
3) If single org -> scope mitigation to that org (temp burst lift or adjust routing)
4) If multi-org -> consider global fallback to previous model for 10m and escalate to eng-platform
5) Postmortem ticket if >30m or customer impact reported

Asha: Also need to avoid alert storms. Add dedupe window and suppression for repeated alerts from same org within 8 minutes. And add an aggregate metric that tracks unique orgs affected in last 15m — trigger a higher-severity alert if >5 orgs impacted.

Jamal: Telemetry adjustments: emit a tag `routing_state=preferred_pool` and `fallback=true` when we switch. That will make it easy on dashboards to see mitigations in timeline.

Tomas: For automatic routing change, ensure circuit-breaker TTLs and a maximum roll count to avoid flapping. Suggest: 5m TTL, 3 attempts per org in 30m.

Mira: CS notification flow: 1) Slack DM to assigned CSM for org if P1; 2) email template + recommended temporary quota increase for customers that pass a quick checklist; 3) post-resolution follow-up if CS ticket exists.

Lina: I'll add the 1m heatmap and per-key table to the ops dashboard. Will also create a saved view called "429 burst triage" with filters and the runbook link.

Asha: I'll open a short-lived feature flag to disable model-x-v2 routing for 10m as an immediate mitigation option. Jamal/Tomas please review and approve.

Jamal: Approved. Also adding a Datadog monitor for unique_orgs_429_count:
```
max(last_15m):count_unique(org_id):api.requests{status:429}.as_count() > 5
```
That will page platform if multiple customers are hitting it.

Tomas: Oncall will test the suppression behavior on staging tomorrow to ensure we don't drop legitimate alerts.

Mira: Sounds good. I'll update the CS playbook with thresholds and the template. Will notify support rotations.

Asha: Thanks all — plan: Lina adds dashboard, Jamal/Tomas implement alert + routing circuit-breaker changes, I will run temporary flag and monitor for 30m. Re-check in 45m here. :thumbsup:

OpsBot: monitor/api-429-rate recovered (severity: OK) for group=production

Mira: Nice. Keep an eye and we'll decide if a postmortem is needed after 30m window.

Asha: Closing loop in 45m.
